note: The OLG explicitly covers this FNS requirement. Under Shelter Expenses Deduction > Allowable Shelter Expenses, the OLG states: 'Charges for repair of a home substantially damaged in a natural disaster are countable unless the repair charge has been or will be reimbursed by private or public relief agencies, insurance companies or any other source.' This matches FNS 1155 on both points: (1) repair costs for homes substantially damaged by natural disaster are deductible as shelter expenses, and (2) costs that have been or will be reimbursed from any source are excluded.
